template.name: W01InsereLinha
template.query: INSERT INTO usertable (ycsb_key, field1, field2, field3, field4, field5, field6, field7, field8, field9, field10) SELECT p.k, left(repeat(md5(p.s || '1'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '2'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '3'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '4'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '5'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '6'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '7'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '8'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '9'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '0'), 4), 100) FROM (SELECT ?::int AS k, ?::text AS s) p WHERE p.k >= 5000000 ON CONFLICT (ycsb_key) DO NOTHING

template.name: W02InsereLote
template.query: INSERT INTO usertable (ycsb_key, field1, field2, field3, field4, field5, field6, field7, field8, field9, field10) SELECT g.id, left(repeat(md5(g.id || '1'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '2'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '3'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '4'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '5'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '6'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '7'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '8'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '9'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(g.id || '0'), 4), 100) FROM (SELECT ?::int AS k) p, generate_series(p.k, p.k + 49) AS g(id) WHERE g.id >= 5000000 ON CONFLICT (ycsb_key) DO NOTHING

template.name: W03Upsert
template.query: INSERT INTO usertable (ycsb_key, field1, field2, field3, field4, field5, field6, field7, field8, field9, field10) SELECT p.k, left(repeat(md5(p.s || '1'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '2'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '3'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '4'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '5'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '6'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '7'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '8'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '9'), 4), 100), left(repeat(md5(p.s || '0'), 4), 100) FROM (SELECT ?::int AS k, ?::text AS s) p WHERE p.k >= 5000000 ON CONFLICT (ycsb_key) DO UPDATE SET field3 = EXCLUDED.field3, field4 = EXCLUDED.field4

template.name: W04AtualizaLinha
template.query: UPDATE usertable SET field1 = left(repeat(md5(?::text), 4), 100) WHERE ycsb_key = ? AND ycsb_key >= 5000000

template.name: W05AtualizaBase
template.query: UPDATE usertable SET field10 = left(md5(?::text) || field10, 100) WHERE ycsb_key = ?

template.name: W06AtualizaBaseFiltro
template.query: UPDATE usertable u SET field10 = left(md5(p.s) || u.field10, 100) FROM (SELECT ?::int AS k, ?::text AS s, ?::int AS c) p WHERE u.ycsb_key BETWEEN p.k AND p.k + 2000 AND left(u.field10, 1) = chr(p.c)

template.name: W07AtualizaDeVizinha
template.query: UPDATE usertable u SET field2 = v.field2 FROM (SELECT ?::int AS k) p, usertable v WHERE u.ycsb_key BETWEEN p.k AND p.k + 99 AND v.ycsb_key = u.ycsb_key + 1 AND u.ycsb_key >= 5000000

template.name: W08RemoveLinha
template.query: DELETE FROM usertable WHERE ycsb_key = ? AND ycsb_key >= 5000000

template.name: W09RemoveFaixa
template.query: DELETE FROM usertable u USING (SELECT ?::int AS k) p WHERE u.ycsb_key BETWEEN p.k AND p.k + 19 AND u.ycsb_key >= 5000000 RETURNING u.ycsb_key

template.name: W10RemoveFiltroCampo
template.query: DELETE FROM usertable u USING (SELECT ?::int AS k, ?::int AS c) p WHERE u.ycsb_key BETWEEN p.k AND p.k + 999 AND u.ycsb_key >= 5000000 AND left(u.field1, 1) = chr(p.c)
